capabilities: log food entries via a configurable tag with database lookups or inline nutrition values
import nutritional data from OpenFoodFacts by product name or barcode
calculate real-time daily nutrition totals shown in the status bar or document
track progress toward daily nutrition goals defined in a goals file
log workout calories and subtract them from daily totals
extras: Requires Obsidian v1.6.6 or higher; layouts adapt to mobile screens.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to log meals, look up nutritional data, or compute daily calorie and macronutrient totals from note entries.

relations.evidence: Search and import nutritional data from the OpenFoodFacts database by product name or barcode

summary: Food intake tracker that logs meals with tags, computes real-time nutrition totals, and imports food data from OpenFoodFacts.
